lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular maxima arranged in approximately four horizontal rows, centered on the mid-lateral region posterior to the branchial area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, forming a primary grid structure along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features with a sharp vertical intensity gradient (light upper/shadow lower) extending across the superior third of the flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs concentrated in the lower and middle regions of the first dorsal fin macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct elongated silhouettes with high-contrast ventral margins (consistent with Echeneidae) attached to the pectoral fin region.
